title: Team Companion: solo mode, founder order, coach rights, honest errors (R1)
summary:
Round 1 ran as the Mistral trial and stopped at the 9.5 M cap. What shipped:
- Solo players see only their own hub and a 'Find or create a team' link. The draft, plan and review pages say a team is needed instead of failing.
- The checklist asks a founder to invite before filling the starting five, and an invited player lands straight in their open starter slot. The leader and coaches see a notice with Undo.
- The roster page is folded into one team page (/team/roster redirects).
- Coaches can place players and answer join requests. They cannot touch the leader, other coaches, team info, kicks or leadership.
- The captain's nudges go only to the leader and coaches.
- No user sees 'RIOT_API_KEY' or 'error running server function' any more. Failed loads say so, with Retry.
- Dead server functions are deleted, and opponent players get a notes field.
- Tree rename and dossier opponent (item 9) are on the branch but not yet verified.
The lesson pipeline (item 10), CHANGELOG and frame strips move to R2.
CI was fully green on b466a79 (items 1-4, merged with main); the tip runs now.
Mistral trial: 2 Opus takeovers (item 1 and the auto-place item), and Sonnet verifiers caught a coach-could-bench-the-leader hole in Mistral's first pass. Details and the per-item table are in REPORT-R1.md.

questions.text: Merge M160 R1 into main once the fresh verifier passes and CI is green on the tip? (Deploy stays a separate card.)

chips.label: Yes, merge
chips.consequence: Items 1-9 land on main; deploy follows through 82-release.sh behind its own card.

chips.label: Not yet
chips.consequence: The branch waits; R2 (lesson pipeline, CHANGELOG, frames) builds on it first.

questions.recommend: Yes, merge. Items 1-8 are verified and CI was green through item 4. Merge once the fresh verifier passes the tip, including item 9.

questions.text: Coaches can now answer join requests too. That goes one step past 'Coaches too' (invite and place), and it means coaches see a requester's username. Keep it?

chips.label: Keep
chips.consequence: A coach who can place can also admit; requests and their notifications show to leader and coaches.

chips.label: Leader only
chips.consequence: R2 moves get_pending_requests and handle_join_request back to the leader; coaches keep placing.

questions.recommend: Keep. A coach who places players needs to admit them, and the dashboard already shows the roster to coaches.

questions.text: Coaches cannot make or unmake coaches; only the leader can (as built). Agree?

chips.label: Leader only
chips.consequence: As built: no 'Make coach' for coaches, and coaches' rows are not editable by other coaches.

chips.label: Coaches too
chips.consequence: R2 lets coaches make and unmake coaches; the leader's place stays protected.

questions.recommend: Leader only. It keeps who runs the team in the leader's hands.

questions.text: For R2's draft rail: show only the viewer's OWN personal learnings for that champion and matchup, labelled 'Only you see this', and change the learnings banner to say so? (This settles open question P7: the 'never on team pages' banner vs MISSION's 'feed the draft'.)

chips.label: Viewer's own only
chips.consequence: R2 builds the rail section and the banner amendment; nobody ever sees another member's learnings, a coach included.

chips.label: Not in the rail
chips.consequence: Learnings stay off the draft page; only the explicit 'Promote to pool note' copy reaches the team.

questions.recommend: Viewer's own only. It keeps the privacy promise and still puts your lessons where you draft.
